svg.title: Luxury Shuttle - interpreted silhouette
svg.desc: Small Craft Catalogue (2023), printed 79-80, PDF 80-81. Combined envelope follows larger Deck 2 with broad rounded aft wings and tapered forward nose; upper Deck 1 and smaller Deck 3 are contained. Illustration corroborates smooth broad rear aerofoil and narrow forward body. Rounded outlines simplified without internal walls or glazing.
